assets.purpose: 开篇：先观察用户的一份实际工作，再决定产品。
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one original horizontal 16:9 editorial illustration for a thoughtful Chinese field guide about building products for overseas users. Art direction: contemporary magazine reportage illustration, elegant fine charcoal/ink contours, selective crosshatching, restrained diluted gouache washes in slate blue, warm gray and a very small brick-red accent, clean ivory-white ground. Natural adult proportions, understated faces, generous breathing room, artful asymmetry. It must look like an intentionally composed drawing, not a stock corporate vector, not 3D, not retro stained paper. Subject: a quiet moment of listening in a remote product research conversation. Three-quarter over-the-shoulder view of a developer sitting at a simple table, pen paused above a notebook. Across the table a modest laptop shows another adult demonstrating a real piece of work by pointing at one correction on a report. The foreground notebook has one matching brick-red annotation, suggesting attention to the specific problem. The actual shared work and attentive posture are the focal point; only these essential objects, no plant, lamp, coffee, decorative charts, globe or rocket. Large clear silhouettes remain intelligible at 360 px wide. Scene fills the central 80 percent of the wide composition with a calm irregular wash behind it, no card border. No readable words, letters, numerals, brands, logos, invented UI text or success badges. All report marks are sparse intentional strokes. Avoid the saturated cobalt/orange palette, oversized cartoon heads, floating interface panels, document icon collages, heavy paper grain and glossy effects. This is visibly an illustrative scene, not documentary evidence. Opaque background.

No readable text, numerals, logos, watermarks, tiny UI, invented handwriting, success badges, thick black outlines, saturated cobalt/orange, 3D, plastic, stock vector figures, heavy vintage paper grain, decorative plants/cups/globes/rockets. Use few essential elements and enough negative space; essential relations must read at 360px wide. Opaque background. An overhead observational drawing of three genuinely different kinds of working material, casually laid out with considered asymmetry across a pale ground. Left: a small physical analogue stopwatch partly overlapping a ruled time worksheet. Center, largest: a folded website project sketch with three broad design blocks and a separate margin annotation connected with a fine brick-red bracket. Right: an analytics plotting sheet with a modest line plot and a translucent tracing sheet offset over it. All marks are abstract and sparse, not legible words, not data claims. The differently structured tasks, not piles of paper, are the subject. No large tablet-shaped icon panels, no equal podiums, no upright cards. Fine purposeful pen drawing with subtle wash; let the graphite geometry and one red annotation organize the wide scene.

They share an unmistakably identical original structure: a plain rectangular low building with two dark openings. Models are large, restrained and immediately distinguishable, not technical infrastructure diagrams.
